correctness.rationale: At time t the mixing matrix factors as M_A(t) tensored with P_+ + cos(2gt)P_-. The zero frequency of M_A is C(A); for g>0 the average in the cosine channel retains the two ordered terms at each gap 2g, with factor 1/2 each. At g=0 both channels are C(A), including for n=1 and for repeated eigenvalues (use distinct eigenvalues and their whole eigenspace projectors). Orthogonal layer channels give the rank sum. Each retained Schur product is PSD and has row sums diag(E_lambda E_mu)=0. For K_m, the projectors J/m and I−J/m give C=(1−2/m)I+2J/m² and B_m=I/m−J/m²; this yields the three stated ranks for m≥3. The frozen verification script groups the full system's coincident energies independently of the Fourier derivation, but its finite results are recorded evidence, not a fresh run or a proof of the theorem.
